title: The playground from the entrance path
description: The whole playground from the entrance path: the tube slide tower, the rope net spinner and the log stepping stumps. Passers-by are pixelated.
title_ja: 入口の通路から見た遊び場
description_ja: 入口の通路から見た遊び場の全体。筒形のすべり台の塔、回る網のかご、切り株の足場。通りがかった人はぼかしてある。

title: Tube slide tower and low rope net
description: The tower with a tube slide, held by a mast and guy ropes, with a low rope net behind.
title_ja: すべり台の塔と低い綱の網
description_ja: 筒形のすべり台の塔。柱と綱で支えてあり、奥に低い綱の網がある。

title: Rope net spinner
description: A cone of rope net around a central post, turning with the base disc.
description_ja: 柱の周りに綱の網が円すい形に張ってあり、下の円盤ごと回る。

title: Tube slide tower from the front
description: The tube slide tower as a whole, from the front.
title_ja: 正面から見たすべり台の塔
description_ja: 筒形のすべり台の塔を正面から見た全体。

title: Log stepping stumps
description: Log stepping stumps of different heights.
description_ja: 高さの違う切り株を並べた足場。

title: Spinning seat
description: A single spinning seat with a flexible pole.
description_ja: しなる棒の付いた 1 人用の回る椅子。

title: Post with three red rings
description: A post with three red rings. Its use is not known yet.
title_ja: 赤い輪が 3 つ付いた柱
description_ja: 赤い輪が 3 つ付いた柱。何に使う物かはまだ分からない。

title: Overhead rail trolley
description: A KOMPAN trolley with a hanging grip on a rigid overhead rail, with the start platform and ladder.
description_ja: 頭上の固いレールを、ぶら下がる取っ手の付いた台車（KOMPAN 社）が滑る。出発の台とはしご。

title: Pull-up bar with dip handles
description: An outdoor fitness pull-up bar with dip handles on the posts, and the bouldering wall behind.
description_ja: 柱の内側に取っ手の付いた、屋外運動器具の懸垂の棒。奥に登り壁。

title: Kettlebell lift station
description: Kettlebell-shaped weights sliding on vertical rods, with a KOMPAN exercise panel.
title_ja: ケトルベル形のおもり
description_ja: 縦の棒に沿って上下するケトルベル形のおもりと、KOMPAN 社の運動の手順の看板。

title: Bouldering wall
description: A free-standing bouldering wall with coloured holds.
description_ja: 色の付いた取っ手（ホールド）の、独立した登り壁。

title: Parallel bars
description: Low parallel bars on orange posts in the outdoor fitness area.
description_ja: 屋外運動器具の一角にある、オレンジ色の柱の低い平行棒。

title: Spinning seat and rope net spinner
description: The spinning seat on its curved pole, with the rope net spinner on the left.
title_ja: 回る椅子と回る網のかご
description_ja: 曲がった棒の上で回る椅子。左は回る網のかご。

title: Age label on the tower
description: Age label on the tube slide tower mast: designed for children ages 5 to 12, adult supervision recommended (Corocord).
description_ja: すべり台の塔の柱の表示。5〜12 歳向け、大人の見守りを勧める（Corocord 社）。

title: Manufacturer plate on the tower
description: Corocord plate on the tower mast: recommended age group 5-12, Art. Corocord15-0335-3C1, Ref.-No. 32857, year 2019.
description_ja: 塔の柱の Corocord 社の銘板。推奨 5〜12 歳、品番 Corocord15-0335-3C1、整理番号 32857、2019 年製。
